final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT crewref, COUNT(*) AS record_count, AVG(gbsize / NULLIF(spanmin, 0)) AS avg_ratio FROM scans GROUP BY crewref), step2 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall_avg FROM step1), step3 AS (SELECT s.crewref, s.record_count, s.avg_ratio, s.avg_ratio - t.overall_avg AS ratio_diff FROM step1 AS s CROSS JOIN step2 AS t WHERE s.avg_ratio > t.overall_avg) SELECT AVG(record_count), AVG(avg_ratio), AVG(ratio_diff) FROM step3
